description: Reopen r-sort-3b-lu (English UK, LANGID 0x0809) read-only. On the indexed T and the unindexed T0, reads ID ORDER BY K, ID for: 18 LIKE patterns (prefixes, ? and character classes and ranges, and three no-wildcard literals); six half-open ranges K >= lo AND K < hi; each of < <= > >= <> = against a, e and sharp s; BETWEEN a AND b, BETWEEN e AND e-acute; and IN (a, e). Asks the exact row sets that LIKE prefixes, ranges and comparisons select over the same values, and whether an index changes any set or its order.
